title: 第三幕 甘い香りは変わらない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I confront Fuji Kiseki, and she finally confesses that she feels unworthy of everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her fans' ardor—which borders on obsession—is becoming too much for her to handle. She's afraid she'll eventually fail and disappoint everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki has given miracles to so many people. I assure her that she's an incredible person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki has given miracles to so many people. I assure her that she's an incredible person.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take Fuji Kiseki to watch the younger student she inspired train. She helped change her fellow racer's life and encouraged her to face her future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My words renew her confidence, and Fuji Kiseki realizes she's not alone. She believes we can overcome anything together.
